title: Closed points have affine basic neighbourhoods under ideal H1 vanishing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] such that $H^1(X,\mathcal I)=0$ for every quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ [pqf-def-coherent, pqf-def-cohomology]. For every point $x\in X$ whose singleton is closed, there is $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ with $x\in X_f$ and $X_f$ affine. Here $X_f$ is the locus where the germ of $f$ is a unit.

source.place: Tag 01XF, label lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering; first paragraph of proof, lines 323-352

proof.text: Choose an affine open neighbourhood U of x. Form the concrete vanishing ideal data I of X minus U and J of (X minus U) union {x}, and use the canonical toModulesOfLE inclusion. It is mono since its composite with I.toModulesι is J.toModulesι. Thus the inclusion and its categorical cokernel give a short exact sequence. The quotient-section lemma provides q whose global lifts have residue one at x.

Prove J.toModules quasi-coherent by identifying it as the kernel of the map from the structure module to closed-immersion pushforward of the structure module of its closed subscheme. Closed-immersion pushforward and kernels preserve quasi-coherence. Apply the assumed ideal H1 vanishing to J.

Apply exists_rightDerived_full_long_exact to the short exact sequence and the module-valued global sections functor. H1(J) is subsingleton, so the first connecting map is zero. Exactness gives an epimorphism on R0, and naturality of rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf transfers it to an epimorphism on global sections. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective lifts q to s in Gamma(X,I).

Let f be the image of s in the structure sheaf. The quotient-section property gives residue one at x, hence x lies in its basic open. Membership of f in the vanishing ideal of X minus U gives zero residue at every point outside U, hence X_f is contained in U. Restricting f to U gives the same basic open by basicOpen_res and the containment. IsAffineOpen.basicOpen then makes X_f affine.

theorem exists_affineBasicOpen_of_isClosed_singleton_of_h1_ideal_zero (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hI : ∀ (I : X.IdealSheafData), I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent →
      Subsingleton ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I.toModules))
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    ∃ f : Γ(X, ⊤), x ∈ X.basicOpen f ∧ IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen f)
